d._instruction: Relax while the jelly mask dries.
Now for those wings.
Rub the dirt off her face and hair with the towel.
Wipe the water drops off her face.
Spread the cooling gel under her puffy eyes.
Spray the glitter over her wings.
Watch the jelly mask take shape.
Here come the wipes.
Spray the colour onto her wings.
Drag the jelly mask onto her face.
Wipe the stains off her wings.
Her skin is dry and flaky.
Pull the mask off from its edge.
Let the cooling gel work.
Look at those wings!
So pretty!
Lay each broken piece into its glued gap.
Let's mix her a fresh jelly mask!
Tap a colour for her wings.
Tap an outfit to try it on, then press Next.
Scrub the soap into a fluffy foam.
Tap the power button.
Here come the wipes.
Take the face wash to her face.
Time to pick her outfit!
Spray her wing edges black.
Say cheese!
Roll the gua sha over the gel to soothe her puffy eyes.
She has had a rough day.
Glowing!
The glue is setting...
Drag the headband onto her hair.
Brush glue into the gaps in her wings.
Watch the powder go in.
Brush the dust off her wings.
Pour the fruit extract into the machine.
Shower all the foam away.
Your jelly mask is ready!

_swaps.Label: Mask in its mould on the counter

d._instruction: Tap the lid to open the jar.
